# Vely

> Vely is a free Android dating and social discovery app for singles and couples. Users create an individual or a joint couple profile, discover people nearby with GPS-based matching, like privately, and chat only after a mutual match. Available on Google Play; website at https://joinvely.com.

## Key facts

- Platform: Android (Google Play). Package name com.vely.app. iOS is not available yet.
- Price: free to download; core discovery, matching and messaging are free. Optional Premium subscription.
- Profile types: single (individual) and couple (one joint profile for two partners).
- Matching: mutual matching only. A chat opens only when both sides have liked each other.
- Discovery: location-based (GPS), with distance and preference filters.
- Safety: 18+ only, block and report tools, verification signals, partner verification for couple profiles, in-app support.
- Referral program: invite friends who install and sign up to unlock Premium.
- Support email: hello@joinvely.com
- Main markets: India, United States, Canada, United Kingdom, Australia, Philippines, Ghana.
